events.title: Current Development Status
events.summary: Hello, everyone! First of all, I want to apologize for not keeping you as informed as you deserve. The main reason is that I currently have a full-time job, which means I haven’t been able to dedicate as much time as I’d like to the game’s development. However, I’ve been working hard during my free time and I’m excited to share some of the progress I’ve made over the past few weeks. events.title: Dark Zone Demo
events.summary: Immerse yourself in the zombie apocalypse with our Steam demo! Face bloodthirsty hordes, uncover secrets on an epic journey. Are you ready to survive? 💀🔥🎮 I would also love to hear your feedback to improve the demo; it would mean a lot to me as it will help enhance the final version of the game.
